notes.notes: A quick fix to one of the quest item's logic.

notes.title: Known bug issue - character freezing - restart level
notes.notes:
There is a known bug where the character's momentum may carry them outside an NPC trigger box while activating a conversation. This can occur if the character is running and the interaction command is pressed to start a conversation, with the character's trigger box only slightly overlapping the NPCs trigger box. Then the character's momentum carries them slightly outside of the bounds of the conversation trigger box.

This appears to happen very infrequently, but [b]if you run into this issue please pause the game [ESC] and restart the level.[/b] Your items should be saved in the games state which acts as a temp save file while the game is active.

Thank you for your patients while I figure out the best way to approach this issue!

notes.title: Realm of the Everbound Stream
notes.notes:
Watch me play Realm of the Everbound - set to release later this summer!

ROTE is an adventure game I've been working on over the past year. The hero in this game is a young man who gets stuck inside a video game as one of the characters. But instead of being a cool character with powerful abilities, the player is instead spawned in as a lowly pumpkin.

The player must navigate the world, speaking to the in-game citizens, uncovering mysteries, fighting foes and making friends in order to find a way to escape the game back to reality.
